about: Leader rules read by engine.py. A leader marshals the people of their segment toward some purpose; the player is their nation's root leader. Types will decide which commands a leader can be given and their limits; for now they are names. start_type is the type of every leader at turn 0.

chieftain.about: Leads a band; the player starts as their nation's chieftain.

mayor.about: Leads a settled town or city.
